title: Window 4 (Agent 8, session 3): B = devoffB (codegen B) vs d0 = devoff2 (primary), then d3 = devoff3; optional d0t = devoff2 + REX_TIMER_WAIT_BLOCKING=1
notes: W4a (the default), RUN-WINDOW4.cmd: -Only d0,B,d3 (Agent 1 priority: B vs devoff2 first, then devoff3). One unscored cold run per bin (devoff2, devoffB, devoff3), then round-robin rounds rotated each round: d0 x5, B x5, d3 x4 (17 runs, about 39 min, -PlanOnly 03:15).

W4b, RUN-WINDOW4B.cmd, only if Agent 1 picks it after Agent 11's d0t functional check: -Only d0,B,d3,d0t -Repeats 4 -ColdShared. One unscored cold run (devoff2) shared by all bins, then 4 rounds in a Latin square (each arm once per round, each position once per arm): d0, B, d3, d0t x4 each (17 runs, about 39 min, -PlanOnly 03:15). With one cold run per bin it is 19 runs, about 44 min: too long. One shared cold run is enough because every run copies its bin into a fresh run dir (no per-bin cache state is carried over), the game data are shared by all bins, and every window starts >= 60 s after the first frame. Check after the run: each arm's round-1 run against its later rounds (matrix_recheck.py).

Window: 5 s settle + 55 s warm-up from the first frame, then 50 s measured, so every window starts >= 60 s after the first frame (min_window_after_ff_s 60, Agent 1's hard floor). The runner raises the warm-up when settle + warm-up is shorter, and after each run flags window_before_floor (excluded) when the first-frame signal to the start mark was < 59.5 s. Cold runs too: warm-up max(cold_warmup_s, 60 - settle) = 55 s, window 30 s.

One frame source for every arm: perf.csv (frames perf), uncapped (framerate_limit=0), the same driver (drivers/thread-cpu.ps1 -> threads.csv). Runner flags on every run: --audio_mute=true --pause_when_unfocused=false --native_settings_load=false --discord_rpc=false.

sys_csv: drivers/sys-csv.ps1 logs idle time, foreground window, input desktop, screensaver, CPU util/MHz, thermal and power every 1 s (sys.csv); sys_summary.py gives sys.json for the window. On the interactive desktop, input during the window, the game losing the foreground part-way, battery, battery saver, a power-plan change, a non-default input desktop or a screensaver exclude the run from summary.md (still in results.csv, listed under 'Flagged runs').

Light phase (window 3's d11-r1): a run whose game.log has < 30 'FAILED: path=d:\INSTALL*.DAT' lines (normal boot: 34) ran a lighter title phase and is excluded (light_phase); a window with >= 60 % of frames under 4.5 ms is flagged light_share_high (info). python bench/agent8/run/matrix_recheck.py <out dir> [--keep-flagged] recomputes the summary.
Timing comes only from this double-click run on the unlocked desktop (screensaver None, AC power, hands off). Agent runs of this matrix (-Quick, hidden desktop) are functional only.

arms.note: devoff2 = S2 sources + S1 codegen (window 3's d0, MANIFEST B87DC2D2)
devoffB = S2 sources + codegen B (Agent 9 recipe; MANIFEST 8709476FF4778768)
W4b only: devoff2 + REX_TIMER_WAIT_BLOCKING=1 (TimerQueue blocking wait, no rebuild; Agent 11), only if its functional pair (matrix-s3-functional.json) passed
